| `deployments delete` | Delete deployments matching a filter |
| `health check` | Run health checks against all services |
| `manifest` | Print the command manifest for agents |

---

## `deploy` Command — Arguments

| Flag | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--version` | string | ✅ Yes | The version to deploy |
| `--env` | enum | ✅ Yes | Target environment — allowed values: `staging`, `production` |
| `--idempotency-key` | string | ❌ No | Duplicate calls with the same key return the original result |
| `--timeout` | number | ❌ No | Seconds before the framework aborts with TIMEOUT; `0` disables the limit |

**Example usage:**
```
democli deploy --version 2.1.0 --env staging
```
